description: Proportion of population using safely managed drinking water is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Sustainable Development Goals. This dataset describes the proportion of the Australian population using safely managed drinking water services. Primary Information Source: Bureau of Meteorology, National Performance Report 2017-18: Urban Water Utilities bom. gov. au/water/npr/. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Sustainable Development Goals. Its tags are Australian-SDG, Goal-6, Indicator-6.1.1, SDG, SDG2018. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2023-08-10 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
